Axial view showing a saccular aneurysm measuring 14.6 cm × 12.6 cm in greatest transaxial dimension.

An 84-year-old man with a medical history of hyperlipidemia, hypertension, hypothyroidism, and tobacco use was admitted for evaluation of an asymptomatic abdominal mass with pulsations. The patient had a 20-pack-year smoking history and had been smoking pipe tobacco for the past 10 years.
